title: Agent
description: One agent registered with the platform: who owns it, what it is for, which project it belongs to, and the narrower set of models and tools it may use. scripts/gen-projects.py turns it into the policy's data.agents.<id> and the project's agent_keys; OPA applies the agent's scope to every call made with one of its keys.

agent.description: Agent id; the file name without .yaml.

project.description: The project the agent belongs to (projects/<id>.yaml). Its data class, placement, limits and budget apply; the agent can only narrow them.

description.description: What the agent is for: its mission, shown in agentregistry.

name.description: The runtime's own name for it, e.g. the kagent Agent resource.

autonomy.description: How far it acts on its own. read-only: only reads. supervised: changes need a human approval. autonomous: may change things without one. Recorded and published; not yet enforced per tool.

keys.description: Ids of the agent's own gateway API keys: the project id, or the project id, a dash and a suffix, unique across projects and agents. Calls with these keys get the agent's scope, not the project's.

allow.description: Patterns over model names; the agent may use a model the project may use that one of them matches. Absent: the project's models.

mcp_tools.description: Patterns over prefixed MCP tool names. A tool call needs a match here and in the project's mcp_tools. Absent: none.

secret.description: Where the agent's runtime reads its key: the Vault path under mini-platform/ (mirrored by VSO to a Secret of the same name) and the field. Written by scripts/bootstrap-vault-secrets.sh from the agent's first key.
